The body and limb checkpoints were correctly marked as untestable due to the tight cropping of the image. The Router was not too lenient; it strictly adhered to the visibility constraints.
artifact_review: The Router identified a texture anomaly in the purple leash (severity 2.0) and background blur (severity 1.0). The animal_pose_auditor reported a HIGH artifact risk level due to 65% of keypoints having low confidence (<0.5), particularly in the limbs and ears. While the Reflector instructions caution against over-interpreting low-confidence keypoints in AI images due to domain shift, the combination of low confidence in the ears (where the topology auditor found high mask confidence but potential boundary issues) and the visible 'plastic' texture of the leash suggests real structural/textural defects. The Router likely underestimated the severity of the leash integration issue, which appears to float on top of the fur without proper occlusion or shadowing. I am upgrading the artifact severity slightly to account for the pose auditor's strong signal of structural uncertainty in the limbs/ears, even if not visually catastrophic.
